Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
library(tidyr)


qt <- 6
names <- c("ivt1","ivt2","ivt3","ivt4","ivt5","ivt6")
names2 <- c("wt1","wt2","wt3","wt4","wt5","wt6")
names3 <- c("data1","data2","data3","data4","data5","data6")
names4 <- c("matrix1","matrix2","matrix3","matrix4","matrix5","matrix6")

for(i in 1:qt){
  string<-paste("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/",as.character(i+8),sep="")
  setwd(string)
  namefile = names[i]
  string2 <-paste("~/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/",as.character(i+8),"/am_ivtavg.csv", sep="")
  assign(namefile, read.csv(string2))
  
  string3 <-paste("~/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/",as.character(i+8),"/amcost_final.csv", sep="")
  amcost <- read.csv(string3, header=FALSE)
  colnames(amcost)<-c("origin","destination","distance","car_cost_erp","car_ivt","pub_ivt","pub_walkt","pub_wtt","pub_cost","avg_transfer","pub_out")
  amcost$od<-paste(amcost$origin, amcost$destination, sep = "-")
  y<-get(names[i])
  y$od<-paste(y$origin, y$destination, sep = "-")
  amcost<-merge(amcost, y, by="od", all.x = TRUE)
  amcost<-amcost[,c("od","avg","origin.x","destination.x")]
  amcost[which(is.na(amcost$avg)),"avg"]<-0
  assign(names3[i],amcost)
  }
for(i in 1:qt){
  string<-paste("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/",as.character(i+8),sep="")
  setwd(string)
  namefile = names2[i]
  string2 <-paste("~/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/",as.character(i+8),"/am_wtavg.csv", sep="")
  assign(namefile, read.csv(string2))
  
  y<-get(names3[i])
  z<-get(names2[i])
  y<-merge(y,z, by.x = "origin.x", by.y="origin", all.x = TRUE)
  y[which(y$avg==0),"wt"]<-0
  assign(names3[i],y)
}

library(readr)
AVG <- read_csv("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/12/AVG.csv")
for(i in 1:length(names3)){
  y<-get(names3[i])
  y$tt<-(y$avg+y$wt)*3600 #AVG is in seconds, while avg and wt are in hours
  y<-y[,c("origin.x","destination.x","tt")]
  z<-spread(y, destination.x, tt)
  delete<-which(z$origin.x %in% AVG$id == FALSE)
  z<-z[-c(delete),]
  delete<-which(colnames(z) %in% colnames(AVG) == FALSE)
  z<-z[,-c(delete)]
  assign(names4[i],z)
  string <- paste("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/AM/moeInputs/AVG", as.character(i),".csv",sep="")
  write.csv(z,string)
}

setwd("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/DAS/quantiles")
files1 = list.files()
for(i in 1:length(files1)-1){
  string<-paste("/home/angelo/PycharmProjects/AV/Data/DAS/quantiles/",as.character(files1[i]),sep="")
```
